h1: Wangtai Hotel Surat Thani — the long-running riverside city hotel travellers passing through still choose
intro: If you are about to cross over to Koh Samui, Koh Phangan, or simply need a night in central Surat Thani before moving on, the name Wangtai Hotel keeps coming up · It has been open since 1982, a tall building on the Tapi River that locals know well · This is not a sleek new boutique stay, but a large 229-room city hotel with a pool, a restaurant, and a central location — from around ฿900/night. Real guest reviews say it is good value for what it is, as long as you know what to expect.

body.html: Wangtai Hotel has been operating since 1982 and is one of the most familiar tall buildings to Surat Thani residents · It sits on Talad Mai Road, right by the Tapi River in the town centre · A major renovation in 2017 updated parts of it, but the overall feel is still that of an older hotel · This is not a design-led boutique stay — it is a 229-room city hotel that does its job well, with everything a one- or two-night stopover guest needs.

Rooms range from Superior Twin (16 sqm) to Deluxe (18 sqm) and Suite (30 sqm) · Many reviewers are surprised that the rooms are cleaner than the building's exterior suggests — "very clean, well-maintained room" comes up often in reviews · Rooms have air-con, hot water, TV and a minibar · River-facing rooms look out over the Tapi River and a small suspension bridge, a view guests like · The trade-off is dated furniture and decor that has not kept up with newer hotels.

"I didn't expect much because the building looks old, but the room was clean, the bed comfortable, the air-con cold, and the staff genuinely helpful — for this price in central Surat Thani it's more than fair."

One thing reviewers consistently praise is the large outdoor swimming pool, which is clean and has a separate children's pool — handy for families travelling with kids · There is also a gym, sauna, massage room and a riverside lounging area · The Tatong restaurant serves Thai food and a breakfast buffet · Breakfast reviews are mixed — some find it generous and tasty, others say the spread is smaller than expected, depending on the day and how busy the hotel is.

Location is the main reason people choose it · Central, within reach of city markets and restaurants · It is an especially convenient base for anyone about to take the road transfer to the Don Sak pier to cross over to Koh Samui or Koh Phangan · The hotel offers airport transfers and helps book tours and ferry tickets · The weekend riverside night market sits right behind the hotel · Note that downtown Surat Thani itself is not a buzzing tourist town — nights are quiet, and most people stay here in transit rather than to explore the city.

To be honest, per real guest sentiment: Wangtai Hotel is an older property that is reasonably maintained, but not every room is in the same condition · Some reviews mention ageing bathrooms, a musty smell in certain rooms, and the occasional insect — common enough in older hotels in this region · If you hit a problem, ask staff to change rooms; reviews say the team is helpful · Guests who are disappointed usually expected a brand-new 4-star standard, while those who understand they are booking a long-running budget-friendly 3-star city hotel tend to be satisfied.

In short, if you want an affordable place in central Surat Thani with a pool and a restaurant, a location that makes onward road and ferry connections easy, and you are relaxed about modern design — Wangtai Hotel delivers · Its 8.0 score from 68 Trip.com reviews captures the picture accurately: "good value, good location, old but clean" · It works best as a one-night stopover before island-hopping, rather than a destination in itself.

A tip from following the reviews here: ask for a renovated, river-facing room when booking or at check-in — Tapi River rooms have the better view and tend to be in better condition · If you visit during the Chak Phra festival (October) or peak island-hopping season, book ahead, as a city hotel with a pool at this price fills up fast.

honestSummary: Wangtai Hotel is the best pick for travellers who want a convenient, affordable city base in central Surat Thani — central, on the Tapi River, with a pool and easy onward road and ferry connections · But understand it is an older hotel from 1982, only partly renovated, and room quality is not consistent throughout.
honestChecks: If you expect a brand-new, modern 4-star hotel — this is a 1982 building renovated in 2017 with an older feel → if newness matters to you, look at a more modern property

If you are coming to explore Surat Thani city as your main destination — downtown is quiet with little to do at night; most people stay here in transit → if you're focused on the islands, use this as a one-night stopover then cross over

If you're worried about inconsistent room condition — some rooms are older than others, with the occasional musty smell or insect → ask for a renovated, river-facing room, and request a change if it's not right; staff are helpful

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Wangtai Hotel Surat Thani

faq.q: Where is Wangtai Hotel in Surat Thani, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Wangtai Hotel is at 1 Talad Mai Road in central Surat Thani, on the Tapi River · A weekend riverside night market sits right behind the hotel · It's about 3 km from the main night market, roughly a 1-hour drive from Don Sak pier for the Koh Samui crossing, and ~25 minutes from Surat Thani Airport.

faq.q: How much does Wangtai Hotel cost, and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿900/night for a Superior Twin (16 sqm) · Deluxe Double/Twin rooms (18 sqm) run about ฿1,050–1,100, and a Suite (30 sqm) around ฿1,800 · Prices vary by date and platform — compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Is Wangtai Hotel old? Are the rooms clean?
faq.a: It opened in 1982 and was renovated in 2017, so the building and decor still feel dated · Most reviews say the rooms are cleaner than the exterior suggests · The caveat is that room condition is inconsistent — some bathrooms are ageing, and a few reviews mention a musty smell or insects, so ask for a renovated room.

faq.q: Who is Wangtai Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for travellers who want an affordable city base before continuing by road and ferry to Koh Samui, Koh Phangan or Koh Tao · It's family-friendly thanks to the pool and kids' pool · It's not for those after a modern design hotel, or those treating Surat Thani city as a main destination.

faq.q: Does Wangtai Hotel have a pool and breakfast?
faq.a: Yes — there's a large outdoor pool and a separate kids' pool, frequently praised in reviews, plus a gym, sauna and massage room · Breakfast is a buffet at the Tatong restaurant, with mixed reviews: generous on some days, limited on others depending on occupancy.

faq.q: Is it convenient to reach the Koh Samui ferry from Wangtai Hotel?
faq.a: Very · The hotel is central, and staff can book your ferry tickets and a transfer to Don Sak pier (about a 1-hour drive) to cross to Koh Samui, Koh Phangan or Koh Tao · This is the main reason many guests stay here for a night before island-hopping.
